message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on 18 June 1815 near present‑day Belgium, resulted in heavy losses on both sides. Roughly:

| Side | Approximate casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|---------------------------------------------------|
| Allied (British, Dutch, Prussian, etc.) | ~23 000 |
| French | ~25 000 |

So the combined total was close to **48 000** casualties. These figures include killed, wounded, and missing soldiers.
